paragraphs.text: 1. SEE, Vena, born in light, hath driven hither, on chariot of the air, the Calves of Prsni.
Singers with hymns caress him as an infant there where the waters and the sunlight mingle.
paragraphs.original: इममपां संगमे सूर्यस्य शिशुं न विप्रा मतिभी रिहन्ति
paragraphs.translit: imamapāṃ saṃgame sūryasya śiśuṃ na viprā matibhī rihanti

paragraphs.text: 2. Vena draws up his wave from out the ocean. mist-born, the fair one's back is made apparent,
paragraphs.original: समुद्रादूर्मिमुदियर्ति वेनो नभोजाः पृष्ठं हर्यतस्य दर्शि ।
paragraphs.translit: samudrādūrmimudiyarti veno nabhojāḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ haryatasya darśi |

paragraphs.text: Brightly he shone aloft on Order's summit: the hosts sang glory to their common birthplace.
paragraphs.original: ऋतस्य सानावधि विष्टपि भ्राट् समानं योनिमभ्यनूषत व्राः
paragraphs.translit: ṛtasya sānāvadhi viṣṭapi bhrāṭ samānaṃ yonimabhyanūṣata vrāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Full many, lowing to their joint-possession, dwelling together stood the Darling's Mothers.
Ascending to the lofty height of Order, the bands of singers 'sip the sweets of Amrta.
paragraphs.original: ऋतस्य सानावधि चक्रमाणा रिहन्ति मध्वो अमृतस्य वाणीः
paragraphs.translit: ṛtasya sānāvadhi cakramāṇā rihanti madhvo amṛtasya vāṇīḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Knowing his form, the sages yearned to meet him: they have come nigh to hear the wild Bull's bellow.
paragraphs.original: जानन्तो रूपमकृपन्त विप्रा मृगस्य घोषं महिषस्य हि ग्मन् ।
paragraphs.translit: jānanto rūpamakṛpanta viprā mṛgasya ghoṣaṃ mahiṣasya hi gman |

paragraphs.text: Performing sacrifice they reached the river: for the Gandharva found the immortal waters.
paragraphs.original: ऋतेन यन्तो अधि सिन्धुमस्थुर्विदद्गन्धर्वो अमृतानि नाम
paragraphs.translit: ṛtena yanto adhi sindhumasthurvidadgandharvo amṛtāni nāma

paragraphs.text: 5. The Apsaras, the Lady, sweetly smiling, supports her Lover in sublimest heaven.
paragraphs.original: अप्सरा जारमुपसिष्मियाणा योषा बिभर्ति परमे व्योमन् ।
paragraphs.translit: apsarā jāramupasiṣmiyāṇā yoṣā bibharti parame vyoman |

paragraphs.text: In his Friend's dwelling as a Friend he wanders: he, Vena, rests him on his golden pinion.
paragraphs.original: चरत्प्रियस्य योनिषु प्रियः सन्सीदत्पक्षे हिरण्यये स वेनः
paragraphs.translit: caratpriyasya yoniṣu priyaḥ sansīdatpakṣe hiraṇyaye sa venaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strong-winged bird that mounteth sky-ward;
paragraphs.original: नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तं हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा ।
paragraphs.translit: nāke suparṇamupa yatpatantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhyacakṣata tvā |

paragraphs.text: On thee with wings of gold, Varuna's envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.
paragraphs.original: हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युम्
paragraphs.translit: hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyum

paragraphs.text: 7. Erect, to heaven hath the Gandharva mounted, pointing at us his many-coloured weapons;
paragraphs.original: ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थात्प्रत्यङ्चित्रा बिभ्रदस्यायुधानि ।
paragraphs.translit: ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthātpratyaṅcitrā bibhradasyāyudhāni |

paragraphs.text: Clad in sweet raiment beautiful to look on, for he, as light, produceth forms that please us.
paragraphs.original: वसानो अत्कं सुरभिं दृशे कं स्वर्ण नाम जनत प्रियाणि
paragraphs.translit: vasāno atkaṃ surabhiṃ dṛśe kaṃ svarṇa nāma janata priyāṇi

paragraphs.text: 8. When as a spark he cometh near the ocean, still looking with a vulture's eye to heaven,
paragraphs.original: द्रप्सः समुद्रमभि यज्जिगाति पश्यन्गृध्रस्य चक्षसा विधर्मन् ।
paragraphs.translit: drapsaḥ samudramabhi yajjigāti paśyangṛdhrasya cakṣasā vidharman |

paragraphs.text: His lustre, joying in its own bright splendour, maketh dear glories in the lowest region.
paragraphs.original: भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा चकानस्तृतीये चक्रे रजसि प्रियाणि
paragraphs.translit: bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā cakānastṛtīye cakre rajasi priyāṇi
